STATE_COMPOSITION_STABILITY.why: Same-week handlers still do not compose in every order: an equipment change erases a return that starts next week, a return in race week followed by a postponed race leaves two races, an event change that reaches this week discards the week's earlier adaptations, and fully time-fitted weeks raise the regain cap (an equivalent of D53, so D53 does not close under §16)
STATE_COMPOSITION_STABILITY.holds: A weekly review, schedule change or goal change after a return; exercises not in use; the entry week through a rebuild; D55

PHASE_MODIFIER_INTEGRITY.why: Every row stays inside its day phase dose (INV-01, INV-02; instrument AK 0; the SSCTR phase grid and S4), and D54 is resolved, but the event phase is not stable under composition: after a return that re-plans from next week, a postponed race leaves the old race session in a week that is now taper
PHASE_MODIFIER_INTEGRITY.holds: D54; race week, post-event and taper reductions for every row kind; moves never cross a day phase

PRESCRIPTION_RECONSTRUCTION_INTEGRITY.why: A time-fitted week is read as whole for the caps (D56); a shortfall at a lighter load becomes the repetition target; a SHORT return on the morning of a quality day keeps the quality session; a mid-week rebuild re-projects from the week-start state instead of the week as prescribed
PRESCRIPTION_RECONSTRUCTION_INTEGRITY.holds: The first executed exposure decides the week and the last executed one gives its counts (R19); the return ceiling is the largest whole count executed (R20); practice rows; race completion
